Sheraton Hotel Booking Skill 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Search Sheraton hotels, showing real-time rates and direct booking links using data from the official Fliggy Marriott channel.
- Provides hotel details, including traffic, nearby points of interest, facilities, and room types.
- Supports searching for Sheraton hotel package deals (e.g., breakfast, stay extension, bundled products).
- Strictly displays only script-provided data; no manual edits or additions allowed.
- Designed for queries mentioning "喜来登" (Sheraton); city input required for searches.
- Always attributes results: "数据来源：飞猪官方商品库·万豪集团专区".
